versions.content: If the function EthIf_RunCableDiagnostic is called, EthIf shall ensure that the corresponding EthIfController is in mode ETH_MODE_ACTIVE and forward the call to function EthTrcv_RunCableDiagnostic of the corresponding Ethernet Transceiver Driver (EthIfTransceiverIdx).
